title: agent-catalog curated MCP servers (schema 1)
description: mcp/curated.json: servers run and checked in Frey (and PiEv), with what to put in the client's configuration. Only these are shown as verified; installing any other server of the mirror asks the person to confirm that its source is not verified (AD108).

name.description: The server's name in the official registry (and so in the mirror).

version.description: The server version that was run.

connector.description: The connector entry as the client writes it (Frey: one table of ~/.frey/connectors.toml, T-0067), without credentials: those are asked for and go to the system keychain.
